author: anon-df5e95db
content: Used in Record's Clone impl (line 68). The C function (9 lines) deep-copies a bam1_t: copies the fixed-size core struct, then reallocs the target's data buffer and memcpys l_data bytes. In Rust: copy the bam1_t core fields, allocate a new data buffer via libc::realloc (or malloc), copy the data bytes. Must handle the m_data (capacity) vs l_data (length) distinction. No other FFI dependencies.
